<script>
$props(['name', 'count']);
let name = 'world';
let count = 0;

$state(count);

$derived(() => count * 2);

function increment() {
  count += 1;
}
</script>

<button onclick={increment}>
  Hello {name}, count is {count}, doubled is {doubled}
</button>
